'''Damorian Manufacturing Corporation''' was a small [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. Damorian's main claim to fame was the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]], which has proven more successful as a marketing tool than a means of securing military contracts. Damorian also had well-performing [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], [[Bulk transport/Legends|bulk transport]], and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] lines.<ref name="EVV" />
